rows.grounds: locative of compound vāma-pārśva indicating location
locative of kavāṭa specifying the panel
particle marking contrast with the preceding specification
fused form: yojayet (optative of causative √yuj) + dvā (two) + upaṭṭikā (strip); sandhi within token

items.question: What specific fitting is required for the left-side door-panel?
premises: The left-side door-panel is the specified location.
Two strips are designated for attachment.
The action of attaching is prescribed.
items.inference: The left-side door-panel must have two strips attached.
uncertainties: The exact material or form of upaṭṭikā is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: But on the left-side door-panel, one should attach two strips.
